endpoint_bridge.note: Loopback OpenAI-compatible proxy (harness/model_proxy.py) forwards to the provider via the sanctioned connector-surrogate urllib path; frameworks use a placeholder key. Needed because the surrogate credential is exchanged only for connector-built urllib requests — no framework HTTP client can carry it.
